value.label: Faith
value.description: Faith represents my developing understanding of myself and my alignment with the identities I have chosen.

value.definition: the games, stories and arts Alan plays, takes in and makes
value.label: Fun
value.description: Fun represents my time spent being creative and playful, doing things because they are interesting and not for any higher instrumental purpose.

value.definition: the condition of Alan's body and its upkeep
value.label: Health
value.description: Health represents my care for my physical body, including eat, move, sleep, and hygiene.

value.label: Learn
value.description: Learn represents my progress towards understanding truth in all domains of knowledge.

value.definition: the people Alan is bound to and how those bonds are kept
value.label: Love
value.description: Love represents my relationships, with the highest priority being my relationships with myself, my spouse, and my kids.

value.definition: Alan's personal sovereignty: the capacity to hold the systems his life runs on
value.label: Wealth
value.description: Wealth represents my ability to exist independent from the constraints of the world, including freedom of time, freedom of attention, freedom of location, and freedom of action.
